description: Mobilità - Parcheggi ad accesso controllato is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. Il dataset contiene le informazioni relative alla mobilità presente sul territorio comunale in particolare per quello che riguarda i parcheggi ad accesso controllato. Il campo 'idRealTime' indica la presenza di un sistema di rilievo della disponibilità di posti liberi in tempo reale. Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are accesso, eu, parcheggi, parcheggio, reti-di-trasporto. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
